# Friendly Calculator

> Free browser-based calculators for everyday personal and small-business calculations, with a focus on practical use in India.

## Main tool
- https://friendlycalculator.in/ — GST, loan EMI, fixed deposit, discount, EPF/PF, savings interest, salary, SIP, inflation, BMI, fuel cost, income-tax estimate, age, electricity bill, salary TDS estimate, and profit/loss calculators.

## Information
- https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/about.html — About Friendly Calculator
- https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/business.html — business models and partnership information
- https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/api.html — limited calculator API documentation and access request
- https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/privacy.html — privacy policy
- https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/terms.html — terms of use

## Important
- The primary calculator tools are designed to process entered values locally in the browser.
- Enquiry forms transmit only the information a visitor chooses to submit.
- Calculator outputs are estimates, not professional tax, legal, accounting, lending, investment, or medical advice.
- API access is limited, requires manual approval, and currently covers GST, EMI, FD, discount, and profit/loss calculations.
- API keys must be kept private and used only from server-side applications.

## Commercial services
- Potential revenue streams include approved display/direct advertising, sponsorships, disclosed affiliate partnerships, consent-based partner introductions, proposed premium subscriptions, calculator API, white-label licensing, embeddable widgets, custom development, and digital reports/templates.
- Proposed prices and revenue models are indicative only. Subscription checkout, automated billing, and several premium services are not active.
- Advertising and affiliate programmes require third-party approval. No rankings, traffic, commissions, RPMs, or earnings are guaranteed.
- Personal information is not sold as a lead list. Partner introductions require explicit consent.

## Search and content
- Canonical homepage: https://friendlycalculator.in/
- Sitemap: https://friendlycalculator.in/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://friendlycalculator.in/robots.txt
- Content should be original, accurate, current, useful to visitors, and clear about calculation assumptions and limitations.
